listing.name: Def Jam: Fight for NY (DefJamFFNY Recomp)
listing.summary: Upstream route: Windows/Linux/macOS setup packages; local build from own dump Limits: Stable0.10.7;0.11.0 is preview with visual issues and pending Mac/Linux playtesting. Network multiplayer unsupported. Upstream platforms: Setup packages: Windows x86-64 EXE, Linux x86-64/SteamDeck archive, macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 DMG. Setup builds game locally. Original data: Own USA/NTSC-U original Xbox Def Jam: Fight for NY dump, title 45410049 (EA-073), as ISO or extracted tree. Manifest requires default.xbe size 3,284,992, SHA-256 31cc0d11f7c656b1a6f337fdf7d9bbaac9df11c324a2fb881f7eb639d4be00c2, plus XML and assets/audio/fonts/motion/movies/screens paths. PS2/GameCube data is incompatible; setup verifies and compiles locally. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
